```{python}
#| echo: false
import yaml
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open('side_missions.yml', 'r') as file:
    pursuits = yaml.safe_load(file)

# Sort by date (newest first) if needed
# df = pd.DataFrame(pursuits).sort_values(by='date', ascending=False)
df = pd.DataFrame(pursuits)

# Create blog-style HTML with grid layout
blog_html = """
<style>
  .blog-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 20px;
    margin: 20px 0;
  }
  .blog-card {
    border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .blog-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
  }
  .blog-content {
    padding: 15px;
    flex-grow: 1;
  }
  .blog-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }
  .blog-title a {
    color: #333;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .blog-title a:hover {
    color: #0066cc;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
  .blog-date {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #666;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: none; /* Remove the line under date */
  }
  .blog-description {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .media-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px; /* Fixed height for all media */
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
  }
  .blog-media {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; /* This makes images cover the container while maintaining aspect ratio */
    object-position: center;
  }
  .video-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .video-container iframe {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
</style>
<div class="blog-grid">
"""

for ind, pursuit in df.iterrows():
    # Determine if this is a video or image entry
    is_video = pursuit.get('is_video', False)
    
    # Get the link for the title (use a default # if not provided)
    link = pursuit.get('link', '#')
    
    # Create the media element (either YouTube embed or image)
    if is_video and 'video_id' in pursuit:
        media_element = f"""
        <div class="media-container">
            <div class="video-container">
                <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/{pursuit['video_id']}" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>
            </div>
        </div>
        """
    else:
        media_element = f"""
        <div class="media-container">
            <img class="blog-media" src="{pursuit.get('image', '')}" alt="{pursuit['title']}">
        </div>
        """
    
    blog_html += f"""
    <div class="blog-card">
        {media_element}
        <div class="blog-content">
            <div class="blog-title"><a href="{link}">{pursuit['title']}</a></div>
            <div class="blog-date">{pursuit['date']}</div>
            <div class="blog-description">{pursuit['description']}</div>
        </div>
    </div>
    """

blog_html += """
</div>
"""

display(HTML(blog_html))
```
